units: metres; every plant is exactly 1.0 tall (scale per placement); pivot = base centre at y=0; Unity axes: Y up, footprint circles are [x, z, r] in the prefab's local space, the model front (the Tripo source image view) faces "facing"; glow = {part: [y_min, y_max]} on the 0..1 height
lod_note: tris = triangles per LOD (LOD0 = Tripo original); lod_error = silhouette+surface error in model units

glow_source.curl: tallest part (1646 faces) above the top of the widest grounded part (13950 faces, ends at y=0.145)

glow_source.canopy: y extent of the widest connected part (9116 faces)
glow_source.drops: y extent of the 50 small separate parts (< 2% of faces each)

glow_source.pod: radius profile: bulb from where the radius first exceeds 2x the thinnest stalk radius (0.0175) below the bulb to the top
